Chapter 1134: 5 Breakthrough (Subscription Request)

Chapter 1134: Chapter 5 Breakthrough (Subscription Request)

Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate’s brow burned with flame, like a miniature Fierce Sun, perfectly cooperating with Lin Yuan to take charge of Hei Yu Nest.

“I realized a flaw in my spiritual will previously, and spent a great amount of resources to gain the opportunity to be the temporary guardian of Hei Yu Nest. Now, that flaw is almost patched up.”

Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate thought to himself.

The special resource Hei Yu within Hei Yu Nest is greatly beneficial to the spiritual will of living beings.

However, Hei Yu is hard to obtain. Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate needs it, and so do other Heavenly Venerates.

Only by becoming the temporary guardian of Hei Yu Nest can one steadily acquire Hei Yu.

Since the flaw in spiritual will is resolved, Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate is reluctant to continue occupying Hei Yu Nest, especially as the renowned Galaxy Great Lord is coming to take over.

“With the spiritual will resolved, it’s time to prepare for that step.”

Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate’s mind wandered.

In this world, every Heavenly Venerate from the six Ancient Countries desires to take that step.

It is said that in the extremely ancient times, there existed only one Ancient Country, and later the second Ancient Country, then the third Ancient Country was born.

Until now, the six Ancient Countries stand side by side.

“If I could take that step, I would establish the seventh Ancient Country, like the ancestors, illuminating this world, eternal and immortal, knowing both past and future…”

Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate yearned immensely.

Why do the Heavenly Venerates follow the commands of the Ancient Countries? It’s all to enhance the possibility of taking that step.

“Over the years, I’ve amassed enough merits, enough to exchange for a chance to possess an ancestor, to experience the height and vision of an ancestor in advance…”

Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate served the Fierce Sun Ancient Country for many years. With the strength of a Heavenly Venerate, he experienced hundreds of wars with other Ancient Countries and reaped benefits from sitting at resource strongholds.

He has accumulated a hundred billion merits.

Enough to possess an ancestor once.

“I’ve lived long enough; continuing further would be merely endless repetition.”

Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate understands the risks of taking that step, even if he has prepared for years and added the final ancestor possession. The hope remains slim.

But however slim, it is still hope. Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate feels he should take a chance; at worst, he would fully immerse himself within some looped time segment.

…

Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate continued to instruct Lin Yuan, as he prepared to take that step, seeing everything with clarity.

What do struggles between Heavenly Venerates and royal families matter?

If he succeeded in establishing the seventh Ancient Country, those struggles would naturally be forgotten.

If failed, immersed in a time loop, those struggles hold no meaning to him.

Therefore, Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate’s instructions to Lin Yuan were quite sincere, with no hidden misguidance.

After instructing, Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate directly left, disappearing into the Space-Time Teleportation Formation from Hei Yu Nest.

Lin Yuan smoothly took over this top-tier resource stronghold, commanding all the grand formations and killing formations of Hei Yu Nest.

…

“It’s due to King Chibao that this went so smoothly.” Lin Yuan smiled and said to King Chibao.

“Strange.”

King Chibao frowned in thought, “Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate always acts extremely dominantly; back then, to compete for the temporary guardian opportunity of Hei Yu Nest, he nearly completely offended four to five other Heavenly Venerates. That’s why outsiders speculated that Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate had a great demand for Hei Yu. Now he abandons it so easily?”

King Chibao seemed full of doubt, “But this resource stronghold, he indeed gave it up, without doing any secret tricks, directly leaving, and Galaxy, you have fully taken charge of all the grand formations and killing formations of Hei Yu Nest…”

“Regardless of Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate’s nature, he has indeed treated me well.”

Lin Yuan said: “His instructions to me just now were indeed reasonable.”

“They are indeed reasonable.” King Chibao nodded, “That’s why I didn’t say anything from start to finish. What Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate told you were all things to be cautious about when stationing at a resource stronghold on the border.”

“Forget it.” King Chibao pondered for a moment, then shook his head, saying: “Anyway, this matter is a good thing, smoothly taking over Hei Yu Nest saves a lot of time; I originally intended to speak thoroughly with Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate…”

“Yes, it’s a good thing.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Taking over this top-tier resource stronghold without a hitch is indeed good.

Even holding an imperial decree from the Ancient Country, if a strong figure like Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate were to secretly obstruct, it would be troublesome. Since none of that happened, Lin Yuan was quite satisfied.

…

“Galaxy, how do you plan to station at this resource stronghold?” King Chibao asked Lin Yuan.

“I’ll station with a clone.” Lin Yuan’s thought subtly moved, and his Taiyin Primordial Spirit emerged, entering the core of Hei Yu Nest, commanding all the grand formations and killing formations.

The guardians of resource strongholds rarely use their true form, usually stationing with clones, incarnations, or simply subordinates.

Each resource stronghold has a Space-Time Teleportation Formation, besides grand formations and killing formations for protection. If any unforeseen event occurs, as long as it lasts ten breaths, it’s enough for guardians to provide support.

“A clone is best.”

“After all, this is a top-tier resource stronghold.”

King Chibao nodded, even Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate stationed at Hei Yu Nest with a clone.

Top-tier resource strongholds are extremely valuable; dispatching incarnations or subordinates to guard remains unreliable.

“Let’s go to the next stronghold.”

King Chibao immediately brought Lin Yuan into the Space-Time Teleportation Formation, heading to Lin Yuan’s second resource stronghold.

…

Deep within Hei Yu Nest.

Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit sat cross-legged.
